title: Habit tracker with streaks and a weekly grid
when: The user wants to track daily habits, tick them off each day and see current and longest streaks.
prompt:
Goal: One tap check ins on a weekly grid with streaks computed in local dates, correct across months.
Steps:
1. Habit { id, name, color, days: [YYYY-MM-DD] }; build keys from getFullYear, getMonth and getDate, never toISOString.
2. logic.mjs: toggleDay, currentStreak(days, today) counting back from today or from yesterday when today is open, longestStreak, completionRate(days, from, to).
3. Grid table: rows are habits, columns the last 7 days with weekday th headers; each cell a button with aria-pressed and aria-label "Read, Tuesday 14, done".
4. Add, rename and archive habits; Up and Down buttons to reorder.
5. Show "5 day streak" and the rate per habit as text; optional month heat map.
6. Persist in localStorage habits.v1 guarded; export JSON.
7. test.mjs: streak across a month end, a gap resets it, today pending keeps yesterday streak.
Quality bar:
- Checking in takes one tap.
- State is visible without color.
- Week fits a phone screen.
Pitfalls:
- UTC date keys that flip near midnight.
- Streak broken just because today is not ticked yet.
- Unlabeled icon buttons.
Verify:
- [ ] Cells have aria-pressed.
- [ ] Headers are th.
- [ ] Data reloads.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (dates and streaks), test.mjs.

examples.input: app para acompanhar meus habitos diarios
examples.output: rows Read/Run/Water, 7 day buttons, "12 day streak", longest streak
